description: This file implements a Slack thread timestamp resolver with caching, including functions to normalize thread timestamps, resolve them from message history, and manage cache entries with TTL and size limits.

methods.name: normalizeThreadTs
methods.description: Normalizes a thread timestamp string by trimming whitespace or returning undefined if invalid.

methods.name: resolveThreadTsFromHistory
methods.description: Fetches message history from Slack API to resolve the thread timestamp for a specific message.

methods.name: createSlackThreadTsResolver
methods.description: Creates a resolver function that manages thread timestamp resolution with caching, TTL, and size limits.
